external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: Customer who browses and orders socks through the mobile app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: marketing
external_entities.description: Marketing function that maintains the product catalogue.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

external_entities.name: marketing laptop
external_entities.description: Laptop in the office where the catalogue spreadsheet resides.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: Mobile application through which customers browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: API used by the mobile app and connected to the user database and SIMS.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
processes.notes: Authentication is not known: "Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication".

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: Stock and inventory system that processes orders, writes delivery addresses, and sends dispatch notes.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS does two things with an order.

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: Gateway that sends dispatch confirmations by fax to the number stored against an order.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway
processes.notes: Nobody checks whether the fax arrived at the right place.

processes.name: spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: Database containing customer names, addresses, and the cards they paid with.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: File containing delivery addresses written by SIMS.
data_stores.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file kept alongside it
data_stores.notes: Only addresses are stored in the file. The text does not state whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: Spreadsheet containing the product catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.
data_stores.notes: The spreadsheet contains macros that send SQL statements to the web API.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering interaction with the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: talk to API
data_flows.description: Mobile app communication with the web API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS

data_flows.name: keep customers
data_flows.description: Web API storage of customer information in the user database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database
data_flows.data_description: Customer name, address, and payment card

data_flows.name: hand over order
data_flows.description: Web API handoff of an order to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address to the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: Fax gateway sends the customer a confirmation containing their name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.name: keep catalogue
data_flows.description: Marketing maintains the product catalogue in the spreadsheet.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: Office location containing the marketing laptop and catalogue spreadsheet.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The mobile app presents a non-web interface.
assumptions.basis: The source explicitly describes it as a mobile app and states there is no website.

assumptions.assumption: The user database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores customer names, addresses, and payment card information.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores delivery addresses, which identify or describe customers.

assumptions.assumption: The catalogue spreadsheet contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains commercially sensitive product prices and product copy.
